original_title: Iran: WFP Middle East Regional Escalation Emergency Response External Situation Report #9, 3 May 2026
title: Iran: WFP Middle East Regional Escalation Emergency Response External Situation Report #9, 3 May 2026
original_summary:
Country: Iran (Islamic Republic of)
Source: World Food Programme

Please refer to the attached file.

N NUMBERS

650,000 displaced people assisted in Lebanon with food and cash to date.

125,274 displaced people received date bars at Syria crossings.

33,500 refugees in settlement supported with food and cash assistance in Iran.

KEY HIGHLIGHTS

  • The ripple effects of the Middle East continue to threaten millions of already food‑insecure people worldwide with further erosion of their access to nutritious food. As needs surge, WFP is accelerating efforts to scale up assistance, rebuild critically depleted stocks, and restore supply lines disrupted by weeks of sustained disruption.
  • In Iran, WFP assistance continues uninterrupted, reaching 33,424 refugees across 20 settlements, with cash assistance arrangement underway to support additional refugees referred by the authorities.
  • Lebanon’s situation is becoming increasingly alarming, with nearly a quarter of the population now facing acute food insecurity, particularly in the south, where conditions are deteriorating most sharply and vulnerabilities are rapidly intensifying. WFP continues to respond to the urgent needs of people affected by the ongoing conflict through food and cash assistance in shelters and communities along with convoys with the logistics cluster to hard-to-reach areas. Over the next four months, WFP urgently requires immediate and flexible funding of USD 44.1 million per month to sustain critical assistance for conflict‑affected people.

original_title: Southern Lebanon: Israeli strikes kill one, wounds rescuers
title: Southern Lebanon: Israeli strikes kill one, wounds rescuers
original_summary:
Israel has carried out fresh air strikes in southern Lebanon. Officials there said at least one person was killed and four others were wounded.

The strikes came after the Israel Defense Forces issued new evacuation warnings on Sunday for residents in more than ten villages and towns, including the city of Nabatieh. Residents were ordered to leave their homes and move at least 1,000 metres away to open areas.

The hostilities are continuing despite a ceasefire signed last month between Israel and Lebanon, which was intended to halt the fighting with Iran-backed Hezbollah.

Israel has accused Hezbollah of repeated violations of the truce. France 24 International affairs editor Shirli Sitbon shares further insights.
